prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: albedo texture projection source for the Hesper buckler emitter, a colonial guard's emitter rebuilt by the Hesperians, a personal shield of 800.
Input image 1 is the EXACT orthographic model guide and is the edit target. Input image 2, design_reference.png, is ONLY the approved colour/material/design authority. Paint image 1 in place. The guide, not the design art, determines camera, silhouette, geometry and composition.
Return a single 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent background. Retain image 1's exact pixel silhouette, outer contour, holes, size, position, every part boundary and occlusion; nothing outside it, nothing cropped, no rotation, no perspective change, no rearrangement, no added geometry. Keep all empty holes transparent. Do not render the design reference's three-quarter pose.
Paint the reference materials onto corresponding existing parts: warm off-white ceramic panels with restrained fine cracks, chips and wear; brushed antique gold structural ribs, rim and fittings with fine engraved seams; black-violet resin understructure and grip, with restrained dark leather-like wrapping where shown; small blue-white energy inserts where the design has lights. Continue hidden sides plausibly in the same materials. Preserve the reference's small non-letter seams, joins and engraved details. Do not invent orange lights, cloth, paper, symbols or text where the reference has none.
LIGHTING IS FLAT ALBEDO: evenly lit from the viewer, shadowless diffuse base colours everywhere including recesses and underside. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion shading, no directional light, no strong specular highlights, no reflections or rim lighting. Gold is its muted warm base colour with only the faintest sheen; white panels have no lighting gradients. Energy parts are painted their bright blue-white colour without bloom spilling onto neighbours or into transparency. Show material microtexture and shallow painted seams, not scene lighting. No floor, background, shadow, labels, letters, numerals or watermark.
VIEW-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Paint guide_front.png exactly. This is the low edge-on FRONT view, not the circular shield face. Keep the broad shallow curved upper shell from about y=220 to y=470, the central elongated vertical fitting, the existing left/right lower tabs and the lower centre underside exactly where the guide places them. Broad shell panels are ceramic; structural bridges/straps are gold with small ceramic insets; the underlying ring is black-violet resin. Do not put a large circular glowing core on the edge-on central fitting: the face-on core belongs to the top view.
reason: Rejected initial return: shifted silhouette, strong baked shadows/highlights, and 1254 x 1254 dimensions. One corrective generation requested.
